description: A chat's queue, as its host keeps it: the messages written while its turn runs, the same on every head that opens the chat, on any machine. Its host leads it: as a turn ends it sends them all, as one message, unless a revert stopped the turn; a message queued once no turn's going goes at once.

upto.description: The one whose send-now stopped the turn: as it ends, it and those before it are sent, the rest kept.

rev.description: Its revision: one more with every change, never less (a head drops one it's seen a later revision than).
